description: Default capability set for CorpusMind Lens desktop (own repo, own identity). v0.2.1: the tauri-plugin-{shell,fs,http} entries were removed because those plugins were declared in Cargo.toml and permissioned here but NEVER registered in lib.rs. v0.3.2: tauri-plugin-dialog IS registered, but only invoked from Rust (the export Save As flow in lib.rs), and Rust-side dialog calls are not webview capability-gated, so no dialog:* permission is listed here. The frontend uses core invoke/event plus plain fetch, which is governed by the CSP in tauri.conf.json. Capabilities document exactly what the running webview uses: the Tauri core, plus the app's own export commands.
